card.name: Linking words in feeding-tube routes
card.fires_on: Small linking words or punctuation such as 'or', 'via', a comma or '(' right after a tube or access route, mainly gastric or feeding tubes (large-bore, nasogastric, gastrostomy), where another route or tube type comes next.

modes.label: Or between tube types
modes.description: The word 'or' joins two tube routes, such as nasogastric or gastrostomy, or large-bore or orogastric.
modes.example: Gastric lavage with a large-bore<< or>>ogastric tube with appropriate airway

modes.label: Via before an access route
modes.description: The word 'via' or a bracket introduces the tube or vessel used for access.
modes.example: instill activated charcoal<< via>> a nasogastric tube. A

modes.label: Punctuation in tube lists
modes.description: A comma or open bracket follows a tube name in a list of tube abbreviations.

card.writes: It seems to promote the start of the next tube or route name, such as Fran or FR (French size), and to suppress unrelated tokens.
card.plain: It fires on the small word 'or' or 'via' just before a second feeding tube or access route is named.
